text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jostling alongside the senior year runners in the Arima Kinen, Manhattan Cafe holds her own with an impressive performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M Opera O likens her to "the companion of Leckermaul," but the meaning of her comment evades me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Manhattan Cafe's friend pulls ahead, moving even further away from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe gives chase, but there's a darkness behind her eyes, and her toenails are suffering. Despite the sinking feeling in my stomach, we prepare for the spring Tenno Sho.
